title: Embedded Game: Improve listing of Remote nodes under the cursor
body: - Add a search bar when 6 or more nodes are listed - Put a maximum height on the menu - Anchor better the position of the menu to the mouse - Show node's class icons ## What problem(s) does this PR solve? - Picking nodes from a long list in embeded game mode is cumbersome ## Additional information Note: i could not test a scenario where `selection_list->is_embedded() == true` because changing the Project Setting or Editor Setting associated to embedding subwindows does not seem to affect this popup (Probably what is reported in #102526) **EDIT:** Stylebox of the popup was overriden to match Editor's. Not really intentional, but a workaround to an issue.
